t: This is Lancaster House, a mansion on The Mall in St James's. It stands beside Green Park, right next to Clarence House and St James's Palace, and much of the site was once part of the palace grounds. The architect was Benjamin Dean Wyatt, who belonged to the well-known Wyatt family of English architects. Harriet, Duchess of Sutherland, died here. She was a courtier and an abolitionist, and her connection to the house is one of the personal stories behind its grand rooms.
